lines: That thought tangled itself before it reached the loom.
I have seen tangled threads with more sense than that.
Careful. Even wool looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken wool with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You have the sense of a sheep near an open gate.
I have combed knots with clearer purpose.
That thought is all tangle and no thread.
Your manners are rougher than unwashed wool.
Even a fence post stands for something better.
You wander into trouble like the flock trained you.
I would not weave that opinion into a rag.
A nervous lamb has more composure.
Your confidence sheds everywhere and helps nowhere.
That remark needed shearing before it reached me.
You make a broken loom look coordinated.
I could count the flock twice before finding your point.
A loose thread has better follow through.
You are the reason gates get checked again.
Even wet wool carries itself with more dignity.
Don't pull at work you do not understand.
